title: To repeal titles I and II of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act.

actions.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committees on Agriculture, the Judiciary, and Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Commodity Exchanges, Energy, and Credit.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Commodity Exchanges, Energy, and Credit.

summaries.text:
This bill amends the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act to repeal Title I (Financial Stability) and Title II (Orderly Liquidation Authority).
 The bill revives or restores the provisions of law amended or repealed by such titles as if the titles had not been enacted.
